sections.heading: Envelope
paragraphs: Schema telemetry.v3 has required fields tenant_id, device_id, event_id, observed_at, and readings. Each reading includes metric, value, and unit. Observed_at is an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp. Received_at is set by the server and ignored if supplied by a gateway.

sections.heading: Validation
paragraphs: Temperature readings are reported in Celsius. Relative humidity uses percent. Reject unknown metrics in production and return a per-event validation result. A batch can contain at most 100 readings.

sections.heading: Compatibility
paragraphs: V3 readers continue to accept the v2 alias sample_time through 30 November 2026. The compatibility path records an alias counter. Publishers update firmware before the removal window in ENG-007.
